notes.title: Limited Operations Commencing!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10635096/4b440c7f65480b6a309c9b3646831795c3d22f02.png[/img]
Pick up your rifle and jump right in! The third and final part of the War of the Human Tanks trilogy is here!

[b]Limited Operations[/b] features over 50 missions with enough challenge for even veteran Command Tanks. 

The original soundtrack of Limited Operations, [b]Sound of the Human - LO[/b], is also available in the store, alongside [b]War of the Human Tanks Complete Collection[/b] Steam Bundle which gives collectors an easy way to complete their trilogy.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10635096/2303ea4343301478276e2208eebce682f7868198.png[/img]
